title: {Syn} Pollard Rho Finds Factors by Wandering
content:
Pollard rho factorization uses a pseudo-random sequence and looks for a collision modulo an unknown factor. The name comes from the Greek-letter shape made by a path with a cycle.

It is especially useful for finding smaller factors of large composites, and it shows how randomness can make arithmetic search surprisingly nimble.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
